eventDetail.scope: ICASC 2026 is devoted to recent developments on the application of advanced computing technologies and methods in physics and engineer research and related areas. The conference is addressed to specialists with various backgrounds of expertise, such as computer scientists and researchers in numerical methods, developers and users of software applications, quantum computing, providers and beneficiaries of data-intensive services, data center administrators, systems of any kind with an engineer background.
